div.div:
One payment obligation for an order or event activation; retries belong to attempts.
ATTRIBUTES (NN required / ? nullable)
id: uuid [PK NN]
default gen_random_uuid()
event_id: uuid [FK NN]
order_id: uuid [FK UQ ?]
activation_id: uuid [FK UQ ?]
purpose: text [NN]
expected_minor: bigint [NN]
currency: text [NN]
default 'KZT'
environment: text [NN]
default 'simulation'
created_at: timestamptz [NN]
default CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
CONSTRAINTS
UQ1: (order_id)
UQ2: (activation_id)
UQ3: (id, event_id, environment)
CK1: (purpose = 'ticket_order' AND order_id IS NOT NULL AND activation_id IS NULL) OR
(purpose = 'activation' AND activation_id IS NOT NULL AND order_id IS NULL)
CK2: expected_minor > 0
CK3: currency = 'KZT'
CK4: environment IN ('simulation','sandbox')
FOREIGN KEYS / UML ASSOCIATIONS
(order_id, event_id) -> ticket_order(id, event_id) [0..1 parent / 0..1 children]
(activation_id, event_id) -> sales_activation(id, event_id) [0..1 parent / 0..1 children]
All FK deletes/updates: RESTRICT. See TX rules for cross-row guards.

div.div:
Provider attempts preserve even duplicate successful charges; fulfillment chooses only
one.
ATTRIBUTES (NN required / ? nullable)
id: uuid [PK NN]
default gen_random_uuid()
intent_id: uuid [FK NN]
event_id: uuid [FK NN]
environment: text [FK NN]
provider: text [NN]
merchant_account_key: text [NN]
provider_payment_id: text [?]
request_key: text [NN]
status: text [NN]
default 'created'
charged_minor: bigint [NN]
default 0
processing_fee_minor: bigint [NN]
default 0
confirmed_at: timestamptz [?]
next_reconcile_at: timestamptz [?]
safe_result: jsonb [NN]
default '{}'::jsonb
created_at: timestamptz [NN]
default CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
CONSTRAINTS
UQ1: (provider, environment, merchant_account_key, provider_payment_id)
UQ2: (provider, environment, merchant_account_key, request_key)
UQ3: (id, event_id)
CK1: status IN ('created','pending','succeeded','failed')
CK2: charged_minor >= 0 AND processing_fee_minor BETWEEN 0 AND charged_minor
CK3: (status = 'succeeded') = (confirmed_at IS NOT NULL)
CK4: status <> 'succeeded' OR charged_minor > 0
CK5: jsonb_typeof(safe_result) = 'object'
FOREIGN KEYS / UML ASSOCIATIONS
(intent_id, event_id, environment) -> payment_intent(id, event_id, environment) [1 parent
/ 0..* children]
All FK deletes/updates: RESTRICT. See TX rules for cross-row guards.

div.div:
Verified callback inbox; save received and processed times independently.
ATTRIBUTES (NN required / ? nullable)
id: uuid [PK NN]
default gen_random_uuid()
provider: text [NN]
environment: text [NN]
merchant_account_key: text [NN]
external_event_id: text [NN]
payment_attempt_id: uuid [FK ?]
refund_attempt_id: uuid [FK ?]
payload_hash: text [NN]
safe_payload: jsonb [NN]
status: text [NN]
default 'received'
processed_at: timestamptz [?]
rejection_reason: text [?]
created_at: timestamptz [NN]
default CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
CONSTRAINTS
UQ1: (provider, environment, merchant_account_key, external_event_id)
CK1: environment IN ('simulation','sandbox')
CK2: status IN ('received','processed','rejected')
CK3: num_nonnulls(payment_attempt_id,refund_attempt_id) <= 1
CK4: jsonb_typeof(safe_payload) = 'object'
CK5: status <> 'processed' OR processed_at IS NOT NULL
FOREIGN KEYS / UML ASSOCIATIONS
(payment_attempt_id) -> payment_attempt(id) [0..1 parent / 0..* children]
(refund_attempt_id) -> refund_attempt(id) [0..1 parent / 0..* children]
All FK deletes/updates: RESTRICT. See TX rules for cross-row guards.
